method: Unique exact lining sets first; adjacent sampled-frame Jaccard graph for remaining cavities
interpretation: IDs are replica-local continuous branches. Split/merge creates new branches with explicit parent edges. Detection gaps end tracks; no identity is inferred across gaps. Spans and sampled-frame fractions are descriptive and depend on sampling and detection; they are not physical pocket lifetimes or thermodynamic populations.
